# WPT coverage

<!-- Generated by 'dotnet run --project tools/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.SpecUpdate -- wpt-coverage'. Do not edit. -->

Coverage of the [web-platform-tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) by `tests/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.Wpt`, at the pinned WPT revision [`63f929364c3e`](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/63f929364c3e05e3432a45fb2ddf25e9eb7b43a0) (`tests/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.SpecData/versions.json`). See [web-platform-tests.md](web-platform-tests.md) for how the tests are run. Each section links to the list of its tests, with the reason why a test does not pass.

The tests are split in three groups:

- **Stable tests**: the testharness.js tests that are not marked as tentative: they test the behaviors defined by a specification (some of these specifications are still drafts or incubations). They measure the conformance of the library.
- **Tentative tests**: the testharness.js tests of the experimental features and of the proposed changes that no specification requires yet (the [WPT convention](https://web-platform-tests.org/writing-tests/file-names.html): `.tentative.` in the file name or a `tentative` directory). They may change or be removed, and browsers often do not pass them: they are reported separately and are not part of the stable coverage.
- **Reftests**: the [reftests](https://web-platform-tests.org/writing-tests/reftests.html) (tentative ones included), which compare the rendering of a page with the rendering of its references, and the [print reftests](https://web-platform-tests.org/writing-tests/print-reftests.html), which compare the pages of the printed documents: they measure the layout, the pagination and the painting (see [web-platform-tests.md](web-platform-tests.md#reftests)).

The columns:

- **Tests**: the testharness.js test files of the section that run in a window or in a dedicated or shared worker (or in a service worker for the tests of `service-workers`) and the reftests, according to the [WPT manifest](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/releases) of the revision, and the other files that are run (a file with several variants counts once: a `.any.js` test passes when it passes in all its globals, a reftest when all its variants pass). Visual tests, crash tests, manual tests, WebDriver tests, the tests that only run in a ShadowRealm, and the tests outside of `service-workers` that only run in service workers are not counted: the library has no ShadowRealm, and the runner only runs the service worker variants of the tests of the service workers.
- **Passing**: the testharness.js tests whose harness status is `OK` and whose subtests all pass with the JavaScript engine (Meziantou.Framework.JavaScriptEngine), and the reftests whose rendering matches their references (`expectations/*.json`).
- **Disabled**: the tests that are not run: listed in `wpt-skip.json`, not fetched (`tests/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.SpecData/sources.json`) or not part of a test group (`WptTests.cs`).
- **Pass rate**: the passing tests among the tests that are run (the tests that are not disabled).

The pages of the sections give, for each test that does not pass, the **Kind** and the **Description** of the reasons why it does not pass (a test can have several reasons). The kinds:

- **BUG**: the implementation is broken.
- **TEST BUG**: the test is wrong: it does not match the specification.
- **JS ENGINE**: a limitation of the JavaScript engine (Meziantou.Framework.JavaScriptEngine) or of its integration with the library.
- **NOT IMPLEMENTED**: the feature is not implemented yet.
- **REQUIRES(features)**: the feature cannot be implemented, or the test cannot pass, until other features are implemented (listed in parentheses).
- **TEST RUNNER**: the WPT runner cannot run the test: a `.py` handler of the WPT server is not emulated, or the directory is not fetched.
- **OUT OF SCOPE**: the library will not support it.
- **FLAKY**: the test passes or fails randomly.
- **PERFORMANCE**: the test is too slow to be run by every build.

The features of `REQUIRES`:

- `animations`: CSS animations and transitions, Web Animations.
- `hardware`: devices and OS integration: sensors, cameras, screens, Bluetooth, USB.
- `layout`: a layout engine: boxes, scrolling, hit testing.
- `media`: audio and video playback, media decoders and encoders.
- `rendering`: painting, image decoding, canvas, paint timing.
- `service-workers`: service workers.
- `user-input`: user input: pointer, keyboard and wheel actions, user activation.
- `web-storage`: Web Storage (`localStorage`, `sessionStorage`).
- `workers`: dedicated and shared workers.
- `worklets`: worklets.

The reasons come from `wpt-skip.json` and `wpt-reasons.json` (`tests/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.Wpt`: `notRun`, `failing` for the testharness.js tests, `failingReftests` for the reftests): each pattern (a path, or a prefix followed by `*`) maps to an array of `{ "kind": "...", "features": ["..."], "description": "..." }` (`features` only for `REQUIRES`). This page is generated: run `dotnet run --project tools/Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.SpecUpdate -- wpt-coverage` after updating the expectations, the reasons or the pinned revision.
